body:
Task 113 asks for all matters and its filings where they filed for a TRO or preliminary injunction.


This rubric asserts that no matters outside of 1010-00005 (Arbor Health Tech), 1024-00003 (Driftwood ARF), 1034-00003 (Jonathan Caldwell) should be included:
https://github.com/harveyai/harvey-labs/blob/a15650fe74bb20b86f160aaabdad75b87a91b6e8/tasks/firm-knowledge/tasks/113/task.json#L58


Looking at the dataset, I feel like https://github.com/harveyai/harvey-labs/tree/main/tasks/firm-knowledge/dms/matters/1011-00004 also covers a case where they file for a TRO or preliminary injunction.

Shouldn't that be included in the rubrics?
title: firm-knowledge (task 113): potential problem with rubrics
